```artifact
Feature: Alarms
  As a user
  I want the controller to detect and receive alarms from the GUI
  So that I can be notified of any issues

  Scenario: Controller detects and receives alarms from GUI
    Given the GUI is sending an alarm signal to the controller
    When the controller receives the alarm signal
    Then the controller should detect the alarm and display it on the main screen

  Scenario: Controller commands hardware PCB buzzer
    Given the controller is connected to the hardware PCB buzzer
    When the controller sends a command to the buzzer to sound an alarm
    Then the buzzer should sound an alarm

  Scenario: GUI enumerates alarm codes and assigns priorities
    Given the GUI has a list of alarm codes and their corresponding priorities
    When the GUI is asked to display the alarm codes and priorities
    Then the GUI should display the alarm codes and their corresponding priorities

  Scenario: GUI displays highest priority alarm on main screen
    Given the GUI has a list of alarms with their corresponding priorities
    When the GUI is asked to display the highest priority alarm on the main screen
    Then the GUI should display the highest priority alarm on the main screen

  Scenario: GUI displays list of active alarms on button press
    Given the GUI has a list of active alarms
    When the user presses the button to view active alarms
    Then the GUI should display the list of active alarms

  Scenario: GUI displays alarm on main screen legible at distance of 1 meter
    Given the GUI is displaying an alarm on the main screen
    When the user is viewing the main screen from a distance of 1 meter
    Then the alarm should be legible

  Scenario: High severity alarms are indicated with red color and flashing frequency of 2Hz with 50% duty cycle
    Given the GUI is displaying a high severity alarm
    When the user is viewing the alarm on the main screen
    Then the alarm should be indicated with a red color and a flashing frequency of 2Hz with a 50% duty cycle

  Scenario: Low severity alarms are indicated with yellow color which is constantly on
    Given the GUI is displaying a low severity alarm
    When the user is viewing the alarm on the main screen
    Then the alarm should be indicated with a yellow color which is constantly on

  Scenario Outline: GUI displays alarm on main screen for different alarm codes
    Given the GUI has a list of alarm codes
    When the user is viewing the main screen
    Then the GUI should display the alarm code on the main screen
    Examples:
      | alarm_code | expected_display |
      | HIGH       | Red flashing     |
      | MEDIUM     | Yellow constant  |
      | LOW        | Yellow constant  |

  Scenario Outline: GUI displays list of active alarms for different numbers of alarms
    Given the GUI has a list of active alarms
    When the user presses the button to view active alarms
    Then the GUI should display the list of active alarms
    Examples:
      | num_alarms | expected_display |
      | 1          | 1 alarm          |
      | 5          | 5 alarms         |
      | 0          | No alarms        |

  Scenario Outline: GUI displays alarm on main screen for different alarm priorities
    Given the GUI has a list of alarm codes and their corresponding priorities
    When the user is viewing the main screen
    Then the GUI should display the alarm code on the main screen
    Examples:
      | alarm_code | priority | expected_display |
      | HIGH       | HIGH     | Red flashing     |
      | MEDIUM     | MEDIUM   | Yellow constant  |
      | LOW        | LOW      | Yellow constant  |
```
